name: Frankfurt Airport

hours.v: flight operating hours 05:00 to 23:00 local time
hours.quote: The flight operating hours at Frankfurt Airport run from 5:00 a.m. to 11:00 p.m. local time.

curfew.v: night flight ban from 23:00 to 05:00; only safety-related diversions, disaster relief and medical aid flights may land; from 22:00 to 23:00 and 05:00 to 06:00 at most 133 movements per night (annual average)
curfew.quote: Between 11:00 p.m. and 5:00 a.m. CEST, there is a ban on night flights.

noise.v: aircraft without a noise-reduced ICAO noise class may fly only Monday to Friday 08:00 to 20:00, not at weekends
noise.quote: only permitted to fly from Monday to Friday between 8:00 a.m. and 8:00 p.m. CEST

slots.v: Level 3 coordinated airport; general aviation flights need a slot from the German airport coordinator (Fluko)
slots.quote: Coordination of General Aviation flights is required at the following Level 3 airports:

handling.v: business and private aircraft are handled at the General Aviation Terminal (GAT) by Fraport Executive Aviation (Fraport Ground Services); terminal services 06:00-22:00 daily, at other times with prior permission (H24 PPR), FBO 24 hours; the terminal has its own customs and passenger inspection facility
handling.quote: The Executive Aviation Terminal Services can be reached daily between 6 a.m. and 10 p.m.; H24 PPR; FBO 24h

runway.v: four runways: 07C/25C 4,000 m by 60 m (take-off and landing), 07R/25L 4,000 m by 45 m (take-off and landing), 18 West 4,000 m by 45 m (take-off only), 07L/25R Northwest 2,800 m by 45 m (landing only)

max_aircraft.v: aerodrome reference code 4E; restrictions for larger code letters are in AIP Germany AD 2 EDDF

ppr.v: the airport user regulations set no PPR for flights; operators are asked to announce flights to and from Frankfurt well in advance; the General Aviation Terminal outside 06:00-22:00 is by prior permission (see handling)
ppr.quote: should therefore, including in their own interests, announce their intentions to fly to and from Frankfurt well in advance
